select c.*,p.project_name,u.nick_name applicant_name from pm_project_plan_change c join pm_project p on p.project_id=c.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.applicant_user_id where c.change_id=#{changeId} for update

select c.*,p.project_name,u.nick_name applicant_name from pm_project_plan_change c join pm_project p on p.project_id=c.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.applicant_user_id where c.project_id=#{projectId} order by c.change_id desc

select c.*, p.project_name, u.nick_name applicant_name from pm_project_plan_change c join pm_project p on p.project_id = c.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.applicant_user_id
c.project_id = #{projectId} and c.change_code like concat('%', #{changeCode}, '%') and c.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and c.status = #{status} and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{applicantName}, '%')
and exists (select 1 from pm_project_plan_change_audit a where a.change_id = c.change_id and a.action = 'SUBMITTED' and a.create_time >= #{params.beginSubmitTime})
and exists (select 1 from pm_project_plan_change_audit a where a.change_id = c.change_id and a.action = 'SUBMITTED' and a.create_time <= #{params.endSubmitTime})
order by c.change_id desc

select distinct p.project_id, p.project_code, p.project_name, p.status, u.nick_name manager_name, (select max(b.version_no) from pm_project_plan_baseline b where b.project_id = p.project_id) current_baseline_version, (select count(*) from pm_project_plan_change c where c.project_id = p.project_id and c.status in ('DRAFT', 'PENDING', 'RETURNED', 'PENDING_APPLY', 'RECONCILE')) open_change_count from pm_project p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.manager_user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join pm_project_member m on m.project_id = p.project_id and m.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 'ACTIVE' where (m.member_id is not null or p.manager_user_id = #{userId}) and p.status in ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED')
and (p.project_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.project_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by case p.status when 'ACTIVE' then 1 when 'PAUSED' then 2 else 3 end, p.project_id desc
select * from pm_project_plan_change_item where change_id=#{changeId} order by sort_order,item_id
select * from pm_project_plan_change_audit where change_id=#{changeId} order by audit_id

select u.user_id as person_id, u.user_name as person_code, u.nick_name as person_name from sys_user u where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) and not exists( select 1 from pm_project_member m where m.project_id = #{projectId} and m.user_id = u.user_id and m.status = 'ACTIVE' ) order by u.user_id limit 20
